Firing the propane burners during final inflation of a hot air balloon, Royal Victoria Park, Bath, England.

images.filename: 2016 Tour of Britain (5) Bath - 045 Javier Moreno, 081 Jack Bauer, 053 Amael Moinard, 161 Eric Rowsell.JPG
images.caption: The four-man breakaway in stage 5 of the 2016 Tour of Britain sprint for the line in Bath. They had led comfortably for most of the day but the peloton is now close behind them and just caught them at the line, just 500 metres away. These four are (right to left) Javier Moreno (Movistar), Jack Bauer (Cannondale, the eventual winner), Amael Moinard (BMC) and Erick Rowsell (Madison Genesis).
images.alt: The four-man breakaway in stage 5 of the 2016 Tour of Britain sprint for the line in Bath. They had led comfortably for most of the day but the peloton is now close behind them and just caught them at the line, just 500 metres away. These four are (right to left) Javier Moreno (Movistar), Jack Bauer (Cannondale, the eventual winner), Amael Moinard (BMC) and Erick Rowsell (Madison Genesis).

images.filename: 2016 Tour of Britain (5) Bath - 033 Julien Vermote.JPG
images.caption: Wearing the yellow race leader's jersey, Julien Vermote of the Etixx-QuickStep team races along the finishing straight in Bath's Royal Victoria Park at the end the fifth stage of the 2016 Tour of Britain sprint for the line in Bath. Steve Cummings, the rider close behind in the white Dimension Data jersey, will take the race lead tomorrow and hold it to the end of the tour.
images.alt: Wearing the yellow race leader's jersey, Julien Vermote of the Etixx-QuickStep team races along the finishing straight in Bath's Royal Victoria Park at the end the fifth stage of the 2016 Tour of Britain sprint for the line in Bath. images.filename: 2016 Tour of Britain (5) Bath - 124 Kristian House, 162 Alexandre Blain, 072 Jasper Bovenhuis.JPG
images.caption: Having raced today from Aberdare, the last few riders in the 2016 Tour of Britain are just metres away from the finishing line in Bath's Royal Victoria Park. They are (from the right) Kristian House of the OnePro Cycling team, Alexandre Blain of Madison Genesis and Jasper Bouvenhuis of An Post/Chain Reaction (who is winning the sprints completion. They are more than eight minutes behind today's winner and there are just two more riders behind them.)
images.alt: Having raced today from Aberdare, the last few riders in the 2016 Tour of Britain are just metres away from the finishing line in Bath's Royal Victoria Park. They are (from the right) Kristian House of the OnePro Cycling team, Alexandre Blain of Madison Genesis and Jasper Bouvenhuis of An Post/Chain Reaction (who is winning the sprints completion. They are more than eight minutes behind today's winner and there are just two more riders behind them.)
